author: kradllit.com

title: Breakdown of the App
body:
Let me give you a rundown of the app so you know how it works and what to expect. The app itself is free, however it is part of another "main" app. So basically, while this one helps to do tasks, it is linked to another app that does cost (about $40 a year). This app is free to use, but every time you use the bot to simplify a task, it uses a currency known as flowers. If I remember correctly, each task requires two flowers. When I downloaded the app, I started out with 12 flowers. I'm not sure if that is the limit to how many flowers you can have in your bank at a time or not.
You can gain more flowers by referring the app to friends, posting to Instagram, or subscribing to the main app I mentioned earlier.
It's a good idea in practice, however, I don't like that the app alludes to being free when in reality, you are going to most likely quickly outgrow the limited amount of tasks that are free to use in the app. I also don't like the fact that there is not a checklist that you can utilize within the app. Instead, once the steps have been broken down, you have to copy the text and paste it somewhere else, like in the notepad app on the iPhone.
  found another app (Goblin: Tasks) that does the same but only costs about a dollar and will be using that, instead.
So overall, a cute looking up, but for me personally, I will need some thing that has more bulk to it.
